# `revision.release`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/revision.release.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`revision.release` (`ReleaseRevision`): the stamp of a release (doc 05 §14.1 step 6, doc 15 §5.5; FR-REV-006,
FR-REV-020, FR-REV-022; WP-S1.18 D13): sets the open revision `Released`, its `date` to `released_on` when it has
none, and writes its `release` record: the sign-off copied as `approval`, the archive's name and SHA-256, the
released generation, the content digest at that generation, the derivation profile, the gate's rule packs, every
page digest and the changed pages, and the git tag when the project is in a worktree.

The session submits it as the last step of the release (`ew_api::Session::release`), after the as-built archive is
written, verified and in place: its parameters are the release's facts, so the session refuses it from
`execute` and `preview`. The command checks what the snapshot decides. Rejected: a revision that does not exist, or
is not open (at `/revision`); an open revision without a sign-off or a checker (at `/revision`: approve it first,
`revision.approve`); an archive name that is not a plain `<name>.ewarchive` file name (at `/archive/name`); a git tag
other than `ew/rev/<label>` (at `/git_tag`).

**Exposure `HumanOnly`** (doc 15 §5.5, ADR-0008 amendment 3): command logs, scripts, MCP and plugins get
`CmdError::Exposure`. **Not undoable** (`undoable: false`, `Confirmation::Destructive`): a released revision is
immutable (FR-REV-009), so the step is a barrier in the history; a release is taken back only by `revision.withdraw`.
Outcome: none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `archive` | [`ReleasedArchive`](#releasedarchive) | yes |  | The as-built archive. |
| `changed_pages` | array of [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | no | `[]` | The pages the release changed, in page order. |
| `content_digest` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) | yes |  | The content digest of generation g (doc 15 §5.4), after the freeze. |

| `git_tag` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) or `null` | no |  | The git tag `ew/rev/<label>`, when the project is in a git worktree. |
| `page_digests` | map of [`Digest128`](#digest128) | no | `{}` | The digest of every page at the release, by page ID (doc 15 §5.6). |
| `released_on` | [`Date`](#date) | yes |  | The release date (the release context's). |
| `revision` | [`CmdUuid`](#cmduuid) | yes |  | The open revision. |
| `rule_packs` | array of [`ApprovedPack`](#approvedpack) | no | `[]` | The rule packs of the gate's run. |

## Types

### ApprovedPack

One rule pack of the gate run a checker approved: its ID, version and the SHA-256 of its definition (doc 15 §3.9).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The pack ID (`EW-CORE`). |
| `sha256` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) | yes |  | The SHA-256 of the pack's definition. |
| `version` | [`CmdIdent`](#cmdident) | yes |  | The pack version. |

### CmdIdent

An identifier: non-empty, one line, NFC, without leading or trailing white space (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 1 character(s))

Pattern: `^[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000](?:[^\u0000-\u001F\u007F-\u009F]*[^\u0000-\u0020\u007F-\u00A0\u1680\u2000-\u200A\u2028\u2029\u202F\u205F\u3000])?$`

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

### Date

An authored date YYYY-MM-DD (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`

### Digest128

A 128-bit digest as 32 lower-case hexadecimal digits (a page digest, doc 15 §5.6).

Type: string (pattern `^[0-9a-f]{32}$`)

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{32}$`

### ReleasedArchive

The as-built archive of a release: its file name and the SHA-256 of its bytes (ADR-0013, doc 05 §14.2).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |  | The file name, `<label>.ewarchive` (no directory: the archive roots are searched, doc 05 §14.2). |
| `sha256` | [`Sha256`](#sha256) | yes |  | The SHA-256 of the archive file. |

### Sha256

A SHA-256 digest sha256:&lt;64 lower-case hex> (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (pattern `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)

Pattern: `^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

Exposure class `human_only`: [doc 17 §2.3](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#23-origins-and-exposure-classes) says whether a command log may run it.
